targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-14 autopsy, V3-EXQ-861i commit-attribution confirmation]: diagnostic, non-voting. Closes the residual 'WHICH ree_core commit is responsible' question left open by the 861e/861f/861g/861h portfolio (qid inv050_mech180_861e_producer_vs_intervention_isolation is already fully resolved -- H1 measurement-RNG eliminated, H3 substrate-delta confirmed -- and its own decision block explicitly scoped the commit-identity question OUT of the frozen hypothesis set and into a substrate_queue entry instead, growth_restriction: null). A wake-only desk bisect (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inv050_reecore_bisect_20260911.md, origin/master 8e1216d2c3) localized a single clean divergence point across the 11 intervening ree_core commits (f810969..17befb8c) to 6293b23 ('MECH-091: wire task-completion and commitment-boundary-crossing triggers into phase_reset()'), excluding the previously-carried candidate 76cbf84 four independent ways. This run (V3-EXQ-861i) confirms that wake-path localization holds under the FULL 861e/861g protocol (training + 10 calibration draws + sleep, not just the wake path): pin A (5f64a53f, 6293b23's parent) reproduces the in-run ANCHOR_PRE (f810969) bitwise; pin B (6293b23) reproduces the in-run ANCHOR_POST (17befb8c) bitwise; and both in-run anchors reproduce their RECORDED 861g/861e counterparts bitwise (C4 met, D=0.0 both). So the RECORDED 0.884 mean_duration_factor collapse (seed 271, ARM_3_HIGH_ON, between 861g and 861e) is attributable, in full, to commit 6293b23 -- not to any of the other 10 commits in the range, and not to measurement RNG, machine identity, or the ContextMemory write-address lock (all separately ruled out by 861f/861g/861h). 76cbf84's exclusion is OVER-DETERMINED (Step 7c red-team finding): its repair gates entirely on `contextmemory_write_usage_balancing`, default-off, and no 861-family run passes that knob -- so 76cbf84 could never have moved a default-config readout at all in ANY of these runs; C2=0 (with 76cbf84 sitting between PIN_B and ANCHOR_POST) is confirmation, not the only evidence. On WHY the number moved: this run does not itself adjudicate 'seed-realisation shift vs MEL-mechanism regression', but two facts already in the lineage's own recorded data bear on it and temper 861e's 'collapse' framing -- (i) across the same f810969->17befb8c delta, ARM_3_HIGH_ON mean_duration_factor moved UP for seed 7 (0.8742->1.0171) and seed 883 (1.8079->1.9747), and DOWN only for seed 271 (1.0070->0.8845): the sign is seed-dependent, not a systematic MEL suppression; (ii) within f810969 alone, 861g's n5-vs-n10 calibration-draw-count variants alone move seed 271's HIGH mean_mel by 10.7% (2.8999705e-05 at n5 -> 2.5865145e-05 at n10) -- the same order of magnitude as the 11.2% 'collapse' itself (2.5865145e-05 -> 2.2980323e-05). Seed-271 ARM_3_HIGH_ON at this operating point sits within ordinary RNG-realisation noise of the factor=1.0 grading line; 6293b23 is a genuine behavioural change (four new phase_reset() call sites) so 'RNG shift' and 'mechanism change' remain entangled in principle, and the standing pending_retest on both claims is the correct owner of resolving that, not this run. Per the driver's own pre-registration and the lineage's standing convention (861e/861f/861g/861h all cite the same clause): this is instrument-provenance work, tests no claim hypothesis, and INV-050/MECH-180 status, confidence, v3_pending, and epistemic_category must not move on this run. That gap is now MOOT: the desk bisect plus this confirmation run have already answered the exact question the entry would have opened, via a different path (a targeted diagnostic, not a substrate build). Governance should mark the 861f recommendation superseded-by-direct-diagnosis rather than creating it now, and should update the qid's decision.distance_phrase to name V3-EXQ-861i (and the desk bisect) as the answer to the 'WHICH commit' question it currently leaves as an open pointer to that never-created entry. SEPARATE OBSERVATION: as of this artifact, claims.yaml carries NO diagnostic_evidence_adjudicated field at all on either INV-050 or MECH-180 (confirmed absent from both full claim blocks by line-number grep). This is a claim-level field, not a per-run one -- setting it true adjudicates the CLAIM's diagnostic-zero status for the whole lineage (all of whose runs -- 861/861a/861b/861c/861d/861e/861f/861g/861h -- already carry governance stamps in both claims' evidence_quality_note), not merely this one run; this artifact recommends setting it now, on this run's per-claim rows, since nothing upstream ever has.
